steps.title: Analyze runtime crash stack trace
steps.description: Examine the runtime exception log triggered when tapping 'Manage Databases' to locate the crash source.

steps.title: Inspect context database helpers
steps.description: Verify how directory paths are retrieved from the Android Context object in MainActivity.

steps.title: Identify empty string query validation error
steps.description: Locate getDatabasePath("") inside the listDatabases method which causes a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException on standard Android systems.

steps.title: Implement safe database path resolution
steps.description: Replace the empty string argument with a non-empty temporary database file name ('temp_db') to securely fetch the database folder via getParentFile().

steps.title: Ensure directory existence check safety
steps.description: Verify directory list operations handle potential null parent files or empty directory environments gracefully.

steps.title: Validate database schema suffix filtering
steps.description: Ensure the system correctly retrieves only '.db' configuration files while ignoring SQLite logs and metadata journals.

steps.title: Test dashboard database count metric
steps.description: Ensure the home dashboard counter correctly uses the updated safe listDatabases function to count databases.

steps.title: Verify active connection switching behavior
steps.description: Test that selecting different database items from the list updates the active connection indicator and layout stats cleanly.

steps.title: Verify UI panel transition integrity
steps.description: Confirm that clicking back and forth between the Dashboard and Database Manager panels works beautifully without issues.

steps.title: Building SQL Database Manager
steps.description: Perform a clean compilation of the corrected Android project to build the final debug APK using standard Gradle toolchains.
